cards.title: India's T20I openers Sanju Samson, Abhishek Sharma and Ishan Kishan are all or nothing: they either win the game or fail cheaply.
cards.headline: The three's Impact per innings is 1.36x as spread out as other India openers' (95% CI 1.12-1.63); India win 90% when they fire vs 69% when they fail.

cards.eyebrow: Are India's T20I openers all or nothing?
